title: Core: Object group/ungroup operations
description: Verify groupObjects and ungroupObjects in packages/core/src/engine/ work correctly. groupObjects: wraps selected objects in a GroupDisplayObject (or converts to a symbol). ungroupObjects: expands a group back to individual objects. Tests: grouping 2 shapes creates a group, ungrouping restores the 2 shapes with correct positions, immutability. 10+ tests.
